new_categories.label: cleaning_function_readiness
new_categories.memory: Delivered dry-cargo hold cleaning or washdown function readiness is a service-state distinct from the resulting cleanliness/readiness of the hold.

new_categories.label: cleaning_medium_supply_confidence
new_categories.memory: Availability of water or another bounded cleaning medium can be represented separately from cleaning-function readiness without retaining exact medium chemistry or operating parameters.

new_categories.label: distribution_path_confidence
new_categories.memory: Distribution-path confidence from cleaning-medium source to a bounded hold or zone is distinct from both the source supply and the cleaning function itself.

new_categories.label: hold_zone_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Cleaning-service scope can be bounded to a hold or zone without retaining hose routes, valve lineups, nozzle arrangements or exact work sequencing.

new_categories.label: cleaning_delivery_interface_confidence
new_categories.memory: The delivery interface used to apply cleaning medium can be represented as a bounded readiness state without retaining equipment type, pressure, flow or manipulation instructions.

new_categories.label: collection_drainage_support_confidence
new_categories.memory: Collection and drainage support for cleaning runoff is a distinct support state and can degrade independently from cleaning-medium delivery.

new_categories.label: runoff_containment_interface_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-procedural confidence that cleaning runoff remains within the intended collection/containment interface can be retained without exact drainage configuration or discharge actions.

new_categories.label: monitoring_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring or inspection confidence that the cleaning service reached its bounded objective is distinct from physical delivery and from the final cleanliness judgment.

new_categories.label: cleanliness_outcome_not_service_equivalence
new_categories.memory: A hold cleanliness/preparation judgment is a downstream result and is not equivalent to cleaning equipment, medium supply, distribution or drainage-support readiness.

new_categories.label: cleaning_service_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Cleaning/washdown service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction or isolation can attach separately to cleaning equipment/interface, medium supply, distribution path, hold/zone scope, collection/drainage support or verification state.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Poor cleanliness confidence, cargo-preparation restriction, hold unavailability, rework or schedule effects do not prove a cleaning-function, supply, distribution, collection/drainage or scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_cleaning_restoration
new_categories.memory: Equipment/interface correction, medium-supply restoration, distribution recovery, collection/drainage recovery, verification and hold return-to-service can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: cleanliness_result_vs_delivered_cleaning_service
useful_refinements.memory: P109 resulting cleanliness/preparation readiness does not duplicate the delivered cleaning/washdown service used to reach that state.

useful_refinements.label: generic_water_service_vs_hold_cleaning_function
useful_refinements.memory: P071 generic water-service support can feed cleaning but does not establish delivered dry-hold cleaning-function readiness.

useful_refinements.label: bilge_drainage_vs_cleaning_collection_support
useful_refinements.memory: P108 hold bilge/drainage service may support runoff collection but does not establish the cleaning service or its bounded collection interface.

useful_refinements.label: generic_equipment_lifecycle_vs_delivered_cleaning_service
useful_refinements.memory: P067 generic lifecycle/support semantics do not establish delivered dry-hold cleaning/washdown service readiness.

duplicates.label: generic_supply_distribution_support_verification_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic source/supply, distribution, support dependency and verification mechanics repeat prior shipboard service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope localization, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.

reviewed_no_specific_memory: exact cleaning equipment, water or cleaning-medium type, pressure, flow, temperature, chemistry, quantity and current configuration
exact hose/pipe/nozzle distribution, valve lineups, collection wells, drainage routes, discharge arrangements, monitoring values or acceptance criteria
exact washdown, chemical handling, tank-entry, cleaning, drainage, troubleshooting, shutdown, isolation or emergency procedures
named cleaning-equipment makers, service providers, ports, yards, cargo incidents, contamination claims, findings or current-readiness facts
negative_space: exact cleaning equipment, medium types, pressure, flow, temperature, chemistry, quantities, distribution arrangements, collection/drainage configuration and current setup
exact valve lineups, nozzle or hose patterns, monitoring values, inspection thresholds, acceptance criteria and cargo-specific cleaning targets
exact washdown, chemical-use, tank-entry, cargo-preparation, drainage, troubleshooting, shutdown, isolation or emergency procedures
named makers, service providers, ports, yards, cargo incidents, contamination claims, findings, current readiness and private/regional/non-English lineages
stop_reason: The bounded dry-hold cleaning/washdown service questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact media, pressures/flows, lineups, drainage configuration, cleaning procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo hold cleaning/washdown service orientation and source-discovery output; not washdown, chemical-use, drainage, tank-entry or cargo-preparation guidance and not proof of any exact medium, arrangement, setting, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
